intro.title: Legal Documents
intro.body: Joyful Trekking Pvt. Ltd. is legally registered and accredited by the Government of Nepal under the Company Act of Nepal, and is licensed by the Department of Tourism (Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation, Government of Nepal).
intro.note: Joyful Trekking Pvt. Ltd. has fulfilled all the legal liabilities to operate a tourism business in Nepal, Tibet and Bhutan. So, book your holiday with us without worry, you are in safe hands and can view our legal documents hereunder.
